seo.metaTitle: Patient Information Form | Sunshine Coast Oral, Facial & Implant Specialists
seo.metaDescription: Australian Privacy Laws dictate that a person’s written consent is required for a health professional to obtain medical information.

f2.value: Home / Patient information / Patient information form

f4.value: Save time at your first visit by completing your details before you arrive. If you prefer, the form can be completed in our rooms on the day.

f1.value: Why we ask for these details

f2.value: Your surgeon reviews your medical history before your consultation so we can plan safe care, including sedation or general anaesthetic where it is needed.

f3.value: Bring your Medicare card, health fund details, referral and any recent x-rays or scans to your appointment.

f4.value: Prefer to fill it in on the day? That is fine. Arrive ten minutes early and our reception team will help you.
